title: Quaintly Wrapped Vietnamese Cornmeal Bun Cha
description: A winey, flaky, and show-off Vietnamese dish featuring white cornmeal, al-dente finish, halal-friendly, served in a bento box.

ingredients.name: Chicken Breast
ingredients.notes: boneless, skinless, cut into thin strips

instructions: Combine chicken breast, pork belly, onion, garlic, fish sauce, soy sauce, sugar, and rice vinegar in a large bowl. Mix well to coat the ingredients evenly.
Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat a steamer or a large pot with a steamer basket to 180°F (82°C).
Place the marinated meat mixture in the steamer basket and steam for 12-15 minutes or until the meat is cooked through.
Meanwhile, mix 1 cup of white cornmeal with 1 cup of water in a small bowl to create a thin batter.
Once the meat is cooked, brush the steamer basket with a little water and pour the cornmeal batter onto the basket.
Steam the cornmeal batter for 5-7 minutes or until it's cooked through and slightly firm to the touch.
To assemble the bun cha, place a few pieces of the cooked meat mixture onto a rice paper sheet, followed by a spoonful of the steamed cornmeal batter.
Add any garnishes you like, such as fresh herbs or sliced chilies, and serve immediately.
